title: Navigation in GNSS-denied environments
summary: Gravity-map matching as a supporting observation in integrated navigation research.
boundary: Requires reference gravity maps, inertial navigation, calibration and processing. A gravity reading alone is not a position fix.

title: Marine gravity surveying
summary: Observation of gravitational acceleration on moving marine platforms for survey and geophysical interpretation.
boundary: Vessel motion, instrument calibration and corrections constrain measurement quality; surveying is not the same claim as GNSS-free positioning.

title: Hybrid geophysical surveys
summary: Combining relative field measurements with an absolute reference to build spatial gravity maps.
boundary: A studied survey workflow does not establish interchangeable performance or procurement suitability for unrelated commercial instruments.

title: Geodetic gravity reference networks
summary: Establishment and transfer of reference gravity measurements across measured stations.
boundary: A network study validates its documented design and procedure, not general station coverage, all gravimeter models or independent equipment certification.
